about_the_game:
WARNING: Contains strong themes of trauma, psychological horror, and disturbing imagery. Player discretion is advised.

ON MY BEHALF

A first-person psychological horror game.

Kidnapped by a cursed entity, a young woman must face her fractured past, make agonizing decisions, and find a way to escape if she can withstand the darkness within.

Environment

Wander through dim corridors, hidden rooms, and surreal spaces that echo with memories she tried to bury. Every hallway, shadow, and object may hold a clue to unlocking her fate.

Story

After being kidnapped during a night in the woods, a young woman awakens in a strange place with others who share her fate. As she searches for a way out, her choices pull her deeper into the nightmare, forcing her to face haunting memories from her childhood and the horrors that refuse to stay buried.

Threats
JUMPSCARES / CHASE SCENES

You are not alone. The creature watches, stalks, and warps your perception. The more you fear, the closer it becomes. Your decisions will ripple through each life caught in this hell.

Gameplay

Explore in first-person, interact with objects, and solve psychologically driven puzzles.

Choose your path, your decisions affect ending and fates.

No weapons, survival depends on stealth, and confronting fear/ certain other mechanics.

Features

Deep narrative with multiple endings based on your choices.

Immersive, chilling atmosphere and realistic sound design.

Emotional, story-driven progression through memory and redemption.

Will you survive the darkness within to make things right?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 590 (4 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 10
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: A normal night trip taking photographs for a contest, Turns quickly into an unexpected nightmare. Where you go through hell, face your past in order to survive in a Story-rich, Immersive, First person horror settings
